messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "this applies if you also use an oral steroid medication when you start taking montelukast"
set: ["this applies if you also use an oral steroid medication when you start taking montelukast", "tell your doctor if you also use", "This also applies to patients currently taking 450 mg/day", "tell your doctor if you also use a narcotic (opioid) medication", "do not stop using an oral steroid medication suddenly", "be sure your doctor knows if you also use", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat depression", "start steroid medicine before levothyroxine", "do this even if you feel well", "temporarily stop taking if you have surgery", "keep taking even if you feel well", "tell doctor if also use insulin or other oral diabetes medications", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to prevent nausea and vomiting", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat a psychiatric disorder", "if you have switched from another anxiety medication", "if you are being treated for high blood pressure, keep using this medication"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set

{

    "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to prevent nausea and vomiting",
    "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat a psychiatric disorder",
    "tell doctor if also use insulin or other oral diabetes medications"
  ],
  "alias": "tell your doctor if you also use"
}
